author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Frontal bust (round head exactly 8 above a user-style shoulder dome) wearing a vest of three charge panels strapped across the chest, taken from the reference's head, torso and chest panels. The current drawing was a ring head over a disconnected 2x2 grid with a separate hook, which read as a window or table rather than a person in a vest.
omissions: The reference's extended arm and lower body are left out so the panels can fill the chest at 8 spacing (the sibling icon person-with-chest-panels-and-extended-arm keeps the arm pose); the panels' wiring is omitted.
